jobs.description: Hi there! We are Testlio , a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work. At the moment, we are looking for German-speaking freelance software testers with various Smart TVs or Xbox consoles to participate in testing the launch of a new streaming platform coming to Austria at the end of the month of September. To participate in this project, you will need to create an account on our platform. Through this account, we can assign you testing tasks. You will be asked to use our website for defect tracking and will receive materials to prepare you for testing. Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you. Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class. Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career. Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs. Requirements Age: You have to be at least 18 years old. Location: Must be physically located in Austria during the month of September. Language: Must at least be comfortable to navigate a streaming app in German. Availability: 30 minutes for your Testlio account setup. For the actual testing task, we are quite flexible, but we anticipate between 2 to 10 hours of testing depending on the test run. Here is what the overall schedule will look like: Phase 1: Ongoing prelaunch testing (intensive, short-term) Phase 2: Launch testing on September 30th Phase 3: Regular weekly test runs (ongoing) Devices: Samsung Tizen TV, LG TV, Hisense TV, Apple TV, Xbox + Laptop/PC/Macbook to access the testing tasks. Experience: Software testing experience is a plus, but if you are new to testing, we offer free courses to help you learn and grow. We offer a preparatory course that will help you learn more about testing on our website. What does testing look like? Type of testing: Functional testing. Type of work: short-term, freelance. Examples of tasks: Install the app build on your TV device following provided instructions Execute test cases covering playback, navigation, and core functionality Report bugs with clear reproduction steps, screenshots/recordings Provide feedback on issues found during each run Pay rate: The pay rate for this is 35 USD/hr . Payment: You are paid weekly via PayPal or Payoneer. We will send you the USD amount, which you can then transfer/convert to EUR if it is more convenient to you. How to start? If you have any questions or need help, please contact Opportunities@testlio.com using the code SMARTTVAUSTRIA in the Subject line/email body so we can quickly identify your request. Once you are ready, please fill out the initial application below. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

jobs.title: Automation Lead
jobs.description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.
